title: Clean Sweep Bot

selected_categories.reasoning: The run lasts until the player collides with a hazard, and the core tension comes from surviving longer while navigating an increasingly populated field.
This is not a literal clicker, but it does share a lightweight repeat-run earnings loop and persistent upgrade spending structure common to clicker-adjacent casual games.
The game has continuous avoidance and collection pressure similar to runner-style arcade games, though movement is freeform rather than lane-based.
The vacuuming fantasy, cleanup theme, glowing pickup absorption, and positive audiovisual feedback strongly support a satisfying tactile-cleanup feel.
Persistent currency is strategically allocated between two upgrade tracks, but resource decisions remain very light compared with dedicated management games.

uncertainty_notes: The category universe does not contain a direct 'arcade dodge-and-collect' or 'avoidance score attack' label, so the best matches are approximate.
The game has some endless-run DNA, but it is arena-based rather than forward-scrolling, which weakens runner-category confidence.
Upgrade persistence contributes a meta layer, but the primary play remains active arcade control rather than passive or management-heavy mechanics.
